## 1. Trigger
**Click Execute workflow** to run now (Click to run). Runs by itself every 4 h. Scripts use the token-checked webhook (`node scripts/run.mjs`).

## 2. Collect (Nexus sources, no API keys)
**Binance** 1h candles (BTC price, 24h move, range) · **Fear & Greed** · **Yahoo** S&P / Nasdaq / gold · **News:** Binance announcements, CoinTelegraph, CoinDesk, Decrypt, Federal Reserve.
Each call retries once; a dead source is skipped and named in the email.

## 3. Analyse (all local)
FinBERT labels every headline (Python :8791, GPU). Gemma 4 E4B picks the 3 biggest stories and writes a 3-sentence 'why' from the data only (JSON schema).

## 4. Deliver
Professional HTML brief via Gmail + JSON/Markdown archive in `markt/digests/`. Prices come from Binance, never from the model.
